
{{alias}}( arrays )
    Cumulatively tests whether at least `k` elements in a one-dimensional
    double-precision floating-point ndarray are truthy.

    If provided an empty input ndarray, the function returns the output ndarray
    unchanged.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arrays: ArrayLikeObject<ndarray>
        Array-like object containing the following ndarrays:

        - a one-dimensional input ndarray.
        - a one-dimensional output ndarray.
        - a zero-dimensional ndarray specifying the minimum number of truthy
        elements.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        Output ndarray.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/float64}}( [ 0.0, 1.0, 1.0 ] );
    > var out = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/bool}}( 3 );
    > var k = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/from-scalar}}( 2, { 'dtype': 'generic' } );
    > {{alias}}( [ x, out, k ] )
    <ndarray>[ false, false, true ]

    See Also
    --------
